title: Module 5: C major chord, strumming foundations, and basic theory
summary: JustinGuitar's Module 5 Beginner Guitar Course lesson introduces the C major chord (noting its stretchiness), then moves into strumming fundamentals, including how the 'overall picture' of strumming works and how to add extra strums to craft patterns. The video then shifts to a light theory segment: the note circle, sharps and flats, and the 12-note scale, followed by practical practice strategies such as compiling a personal songbook. It ends with a hands-on riff workout using Nirvana's Come As You Are to illustrate applying chords and strumming to a real song context.
topics: Nirvana Come As You Are riff
